actions.limitations: Current autonomous objective discovery mechanisms are heavily influenced by underlying optimization assumptions; while PC-PPO and FairDICE address certain scalarization and fairness limits, effective handling of broad non-convex scalarization and long-term, self-directed objective prioritization remains an open challenge.
actions.next_questions: How can DICE-based frameworks be extended to non-convex scalarization functions to support broader autonomous objective discovery?
actions.reason: Revising notebook findings to integrate FairDICE convex scalarization limits and multi-objective optimization constraints.
actions.summary: Autonomous systems increasingly utilize multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) to pursue self-generated goals. Recent developments, specifically Pareto-Conditioned Proximal Policy Optimization (PC-PPO) and FairDICE, provide mechanisms to learn non-dominated policy portfolios and handle constrained optimization, allowing navigation of reliability-efficiency frontiers without retraining. However, the field still faces fundamental challenges regarding non-convex optimization and strict convexity assumptions in scalarization functions.
actions.title: Foundations of Autonomous Objective Discovery in Artificial Systems

proposal.summary: This cycle incorporates new evidence regarding FairDICE and constrained optimization into the notebook for autonomous objective discovery, evaluating the limitations of convex scalarization in multi-objective reinforcement learning.
